items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And that would give me my inspiration to play trumpet by here in Bung Johnson. That's the first trumpet player I've ever heard.

ctx.x: No, he died in 1941. What was his name? Yeah, Cagnoletti. Cagnoletti. He played with Bung Johnson during World War I in Madisonville when they were launching ships. And that would give me my inspiration to play trumpet by here in Bung Johnson. That's the first trumpet player I've ever heard.
What did your brother play? He played drums.
